items.name: SENREP (Sensor Report)
items.description: Doctrinal SENREP-style sensor report produced by SET.

observedProperties.label: Contact ID
observedProperties.description: Authoritative join key for tracking/reporting

observedProperties.label: Date of Report
observedProperties.description: DTG of report (DDMMYY format)

observedProperties.label: Operation Name
observedProperties.description: Named operation or exercise identifier

observedProperties.label: String Number
observedProperties.description: String/sensor array identifier

observedProperties.label: Detection Time (Zulu)
observedProperties.description: Time of initial detection in Zulu (HHMM format)

observedProperties.label: Quantity
observedProperties.description: Number of targets observed

observedProperties.label: Target Type
observedProperties.description: Doctrinal target type category (e.g., UAS, DISMOUNT, VEHICLE)

observedProperties.label: Sub-Type
observedProperties.description: Target sub-type detail

observedProperties.label: Direction (Cardinal)
observedProperties.description: Cardinal or inter-cardinal direction of movement

observedProperties.label: Column Length
observedProperties.description: Length of the detected target formation/column

observedProperties.label: Position Error
observedProperties.description: Estimated position error in meters

observedProperties.label: ETA Time (Zulu)
observedProperties.description: Estimated time of activity in Zulu

observedProperties.label: Source Fix Observation ID
observedProperties.description: Reference to the localizer fix observation that triggered this SENREP

observedProperties.label: Source LOB Observation IDs
observedProperties.description: Comma-separated list of contributing LOB observation IDs

observedProperties.label: Confidence
observedProperties.description: Operator confidence level (0-1)

observedProperties.label: Comments
observedProperties.description: Free-text operator comments

items.name: AZ-MA-1 Detection Capabilities
items.description: Static detection range characteristics for AZ-MA-1.

items.name: AZ-MA-2 Detection Capabilities
items.description: Static detection range characteristics for AZ-MA-2.

items.name: AZ-MA-3 Detection Capabilities
items.description: Static detection range characteristics for AZ-MA-3.

observedProperties.label: CEP50 (m)
observedProperties.description: Circular error probable — 50% of fixes fall within this radius

observedProperties.label: Contributing sensors
observedProperties.description: Comma-separated list of sensor names that contributed LOBs

observedProperties.label: Residual (m)
observedProperties.description: Mean perpendicular distance from each bearing line to the estimated point

observedProperties.label: Contributing LOBs (JSON)
observedProperties.description: JSON-encoded array of LOB records used for this fix. Each element: {sensorName, sensorLat, sensorLon, bearingTrue, bearingStdDev}

observedProperties.label: Estimated Latitude
observedProperties.description: WLS-computed geodetic latitude (WGS-84)

observedProperties.label: Estimated Longitude
observedProperties.description: WLS-computed geodetic longitude (WGS-84)

observedProperties.label: CEP50
observedProperties.description: Circular Error Probable (50th percentile) of the location estimate

observedProperties.label: Contributing Sensors
observedProperties.description: Comma-separated list of sensor IDs that contributed LOBs

observedProperties.label: Residual
observedProperties.description: WLS residual error metric in meters

observedProperties.label: Contributing LOBs (JSON)
observedProperties.description: JSON-encoded array of contributing LOB details

observedProperties.label: Latitude
observedProperties.description: Geodetic latitude (WGS-84)

observedProperties.label: Longitude
observedProperties.description: Geodetic longitude (WGS-84)

observedProperties.label: Altitude
observedProperties.description: Altitude above WGS-84 ellipsoid

observedProperties.label: Orbital Velocity
observedProperties.description: ECI velocity magnitude

observedProperties.label: TLE Epoch
observedProperties.description: ISO 8601 epoch of the source TLE element set

observedProperties.label: TLE Age
observedProperties.description: Seconds since TLE epoch — indicates propagation confidence

observedProperties.label: Estimated Position Error
observedProperties.description: Rough SGP4 position error estimate based on TLE age (~1km at epoch, growing ~1-2km/day)

observedProperties.label: Track Duration
observedProperties.description: Total duration of predicted track in minutes

observedProperties.label: Track Points (JSON)
observedProperties.description: JSON-encoded array of {timestamp, lat_deg, lon_deg, alt_km} objects representing the predicted ground track. Encoded as Text for maximum portability across SWE implementations.
